decisions.statement: The vocabulary is one page per merchant rather than one body under a heading.
A merchant's value is the page's title and its patterns are the runs of the bank's words.
Both the value and the patterns are lowered.
The merchant and the statement line are read together.
Either the merchant or the statement line names the merchant.
A page missing a title or its patterns is passed over rather than refusing the whole vocabulary.
The vocabulary is read once and held.
A page changed under a running process is not seen.

definition: the merchant a transaction's own words name, drawn from the merchant pages
